stemMd:
How many days are needed to complete a job?

(1) Six workers are assigned to it.

(2) Each assigned worker works eight hours each day.

Which assessment of sufficiency is correct?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Even together the statements are not sufficient.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Together the statements are sufficient, but neither is sufficient alone.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Statement (2) alone is sufficient, but statement (1) alone is not.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Statement (1) alone is sufficient, but statement (2) alone is not.

explanationMd: Even together these facts give only 48 worker-hours per day. The job’s required work and workers’ productivity are unspecified, so completion time cannot be determined.

distractorRationale.d: Assess each statement separately before combining them. Even together these facts give only 48 worker-hours per day. The job’s required work and workers’ productivity are unspecified, so completion time cannot be determined.
